```artifact
Feature: Event Logging in GUI

  Scenario Outline: Store an event log in non-volatile memory
    Given the GUI is initialized
    When an event occurs
    Then the event log should be stored in non-volatile memory
    Examples:
      | Event Type |
      | Confirm Ventilation |
      | Change RTC |
      | System Boot |

  Scenario Outline: Include all confirmed ventilation settings in the event log
    Given the GUI is initialized
    When a ventilation setting is confirmed
    Then the event log should include the confirmed ventilation settings
    Examples:
      | Ventilation Setting |
      | Temperature Set to 25°C |
      | Fan Speed Set to High |
      | Humidity Set to 40% |

  Scenario Outline: Include a date and timestamp in the event log
    Given the GUI is initialized
    When an event occurs
    Then the event log should include a date and timestamp
    Examples:
      | Event Type |
      | Confirm Ventilation |
      | Change RTC |
      | System Boot |

  Scenario Outline: Include changes to the system's real time clock in the event log
    Given the GUI is initialized
    When the RTC is changed
    Then the event log should include the Current Date/Time followed by the new Date/Time
    Examples:
      | Current Date/Time | New Date/Time |
      | 2023-04-01 12:00 | 2023-04-01 13:00 |
      | 2023-04-01 23:59 | 2023-04-02 00:00 |
      | 2023-04-01 00:00 | 2023-03-31 23:59 |
```
